observations: Photo 0 shows a metal alternator/generator head assembly with a rusty outer ring, partially open casing revealing windings, sitting on bare gravel/dirt ground.
A yellow electrical hazard warning label is visible on the attached control/terminal box in both photos.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from another angle, showing a terminal/junction box with wiring and cooling fins on the housing.
No manufacturer nameplate, serial number, or model plate is visible in either photo.
The item appears to be used, dirty, and partly exposed to the elements (rust visible on the outer ring).
No video, sound, or power-on test is shown; the unit is static in both images.

claims.evidence: No power-on test, spinning, or output reading shown in either photo.
No coupling, flange, or compatibility marking visible; no engine shown for fitment reference.

claims.claim: Never been worked on and all intact
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows visible rust on the outer housing ring and an open section exposing internal windings, suggesting wear or prior opening, not pristine condition.

risks.risk: Internal windings could be damaged, corroded, or burnt, making the unit non-functional.
risks.proof: A clear photo or short video of the nameplate and of the unit running/generating voltage on a multimeter.

risks.risk: Compatibility with a specific Mitsubishi engine model is unverified; mounting flange or shaft size may not match.
risks.proof: Photo of the mounting flange dimensions or the engine it was removed from, with matching part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/uncertain-fit used alternator head

risks.risk: Rust and exposure suggest possible moisture ingress affecting the windings or bearings.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the windings and bearings, plus insulation resistance test reading.

risks.risk: Missing nameplate means kVA/voltage rating and brand cannot be confirmed, affecting value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamped or printed nameplate data.

proof_requests: Photo of the nameplate showing brand, model, kVA/voltage rating, and serial number.
Short video of the unit running or spinning with a voltage/output reading.
Photo of the mounting flange and shaft to confirm Mitsubishi engine fitment.
Close-up photos of the internal windings and bearings for corrosion/damage check.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used generator alternator head, but functionality and engine compatibility are unproven and condition shows visible rust, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, uncertain-fit used unit.
